name: review-code
summary: Independently review a bounded repository diff, branch, or work in progress against explicit requirements and regression risk.
inputs: work order, acceptance criteria, non-goals, manifests, and relevant constraints
external_reads: scoped repository remote or CI evidence
approval_gates: missing authoritative requirements are labeled UNPROVEN, not invented
done_when: material findings have direct evidence, severity, location, and disposition
tests and regression risk are assessed
no producer self-review closes the task
verification: fixed diff and acceptance evidence inspected
repository, comparison boundary, requirements, non-goals, and review limits explicit
actual diff, tests, requirements, security concerns, and regression paths independently reviewed
findings and missing evidence reported; review does not authorize implementation or closure of producer work
